name: Nocturne's Curtain Call
passiveDesc: Max HP increases by 10/12/14/16/18%. When triggering Lunar reactions or inflicting Lunar Reaction DMG on opponents, the equipping character will recover 14/15/16/17/18 Energy, and receive the Bountiful Sea's Sacred Wine effect for 12s: Max HP increases by an additional 14/16/18/20/22%, CRIT DMG from Lunar Reaction DMG increases by 60/80/100/120/140%. The Energy recovery effect can be triggered at most once every 18s, and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
description: A jade pearl shrouded in the light of the moon. Even in the coldest winter night, its gentle warmth lingers like a song.
